proposal_set.name: full-cudagraph-decode
proposal_set.reason: At concurrency 4 with ISL/OSL 1024 the run is decode-bound and per-step kernel-launch/dispatch overhead dominates on MI300X. FULL_AND_PIECEWISE captures the decode path as a full graph instead of piecewise, cutting per-token launch overhead. Full-graph decode requires an attention backend that supports it, hence the coupled AITER MHA env vars - benching the flag alone typically falls back to PIECEWISE and shows no gain, which is why this entry is atomic.

proposal_set.name: aiter-fused-ops
proposal_set.reason: aiter 0.1.20 is installed. The master AITER switch plus the linear/rmsnorm fused paths swap vLLM's default Torch/Triton GEMM+norm for AMD-tuned ASM kernels; for a small dense bf16 model at low batch these are skinny-GEMM-shaped and are where AITER's dense wins concentrate. Isolated from proposal 1 so the Coordinator can attribute gain between graph capture and kernel substitution.
